sender.bs: „OLX podrška“ ili „PIK korisnička podrška“ na Viberu
sender.en: “OLX support” or “PIK customer support” on Viber

how.bs: Na Viber vam piše neko ko se predstavlja kao korisnička podrška OLX.ba. Javlja problem sa vašim oglasom, nalogom ili uplatom kupca i traži da otvorite link, potvrdite karticu ili pošaljete podatke. Prava OLX podrška ne javlja se na Viber: kontaktira se samo telefonom ili kontakt formom.
how.en: Someone writes to you on Viber claiming to be OLX.ba customer support. They report a problem with your listing, account or a buyer’s payment and ask you to open a link, confirm your card or send your details. Real OLX support doesn’t contact you on Viber: it is reached only by phone or the contact form.

text.bs: Viber poruka od „OLX podrške“ s nepoznatog broja.
text.en: A Viber message from “OLX support” from an unknown number.

text.bs: Problem s oglasom ili „uplatom koja čeka“.
text.en: A problem with your listing or a “pending payment”.
A link for “verification” or card confirmation.
They ask for card details or a code.

text.bs: OLX podrska: Kupac je uplatio iznos za vas artikal, ali isplata je zaustavljena jer vas profil nije verifikovan. Verifikujte karticu u roku od 2 sata kako sredstva ne bi bila vracena: [link]
text.en: OLX support: A buyer has paid for your item, but the payout is on hold because your profile isn’t verified. Verify your card within 2 hours so the funds aren’t returned: [link]

en: olx support messaged me on viber
viber message to verify my olx profile
fake olx support asking for my card
payout for my listing on hold verification

bs: OLX podrška ne piše na Viber.
Za registraciju i prodaju na OLX.ba ne trebaju podaci kartice.
Rok od par sati i prijetnja da će novac biti vraćen.
en: OLX support doesn’t write on Viber.
You don’t need card details to register or sell on OLX.ba.
A deadline of a few hours and a threat that the money will be returned.

bs: Ne odgovarajte i ne otvarajte link; provjerite broj s kojeg je poruka stigla.
Ako niste sigurni, javite se OLX podršci sami, telefonom ili kontakt formom.
Ako ste dali podatke kartice, odmah zovite banku i prijavite policiji (122).
en: Don’t reply or open the link; check the number the message came from.
If unsure, contact OLX support yourself, by phone or the contact form.
If you gave card details, call your bank at once and report it to the police (122).
